title: 第七章 进步第八章 感官第九章 变化
slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
一个小时后。
陈洛佝偻着腰，扶着墙面，从厕所内缓步走出。
他第一时间打开排风扇，顺带关上厕所门，将地狱留在门的另外一侧。
“大舅哥，没事吧？”
正在开黑的舍友摘下耳机，关切打量着他。
“还行。”
陈洛摆摆手，拖着沉重的身体走出阳台。
摊在椅子上，无神凝望天花板，他长吁一口气，颇有种如释重负的释然。
词条在增强五脏六腑功能的同时，似乎也以十分粗暴的方式，修复着身体。
陈洛今年二十二岁，虽然还年轻，但由于早早便建立了熬夜、饮食不规律等不良习惯，肯定称不上多健康。
这间接导致【脏腑强化】的融合过程，变得十分折磨和漫长。
好在，是值得的。
“呼——”
短暂休息了几分钟。
陈洛再度长吁一口气，挺直腰板，坐姿端正。
他拿起桌上的镜子。
先前刚从厕所走出时，脸色还是苍白如纸。
而现在。
一呼一吸间，随着空气不断灌入肺部，转化为力量输送到身体各处。
他的脸色，以肉眼可见的速度变得红润。

身体的疲乏迅速褪去，被源源不断生成的体力取代。
每一分每一秒，他的精神都变得更加振奋，身体愈发轻盈，颇有种脱胎换骨的新鲜感。
但，感觉终究是感觉。
身体的变化如何，还需要进行实际测试。
陈洛看了眼时间。
现在是下午五点半，距离集训结束还有一个小时。
过去混混脸熟，找找词条，顺带测试身体的变化，正正好。
想到这里。
陈洛起身离开宿舍，赶往操场。
.......
五分钟后。
陈洛抵达跑道边时，丁伟等长跑选手，似乎刚刚进行完一轮练习，正站在旁边休息。
至于那些凑热闹的同学，则三两成群坐在草坪上，乐呵呵地观摩着练习的选手。
“孩子们，你们的爸爸回来了。”
来到跑道边，陈洛张开双臂，君临天下。
“艹，怎么...没拉死你个龟孙。”
丁伟即便呼吸急促，也不忘竖起一根中指。
“大舅哥？你不是请假吗？”
李佳乐小跑而来，看上去有些惊喜。
“刚刚拉肚子，现在好多了，就赶来训练一会。”

闻言。
李佳乐疑惑地上下打量着陈洛。
见他一副红光满面，精神换发的模样，说是吃春药都不为过，哪里像个刚拉完肚子的人。
而且陈洛看着...好像比昨天壮了一点？
content_en:
An hour later.
Chen Luo bent his waist, supported the wall, and walked slowly out of the toilet.
He immediately turned on the exhaust fan and closed the toilet door, leaving hell on the other side of the door.
"Uncle, are you okay?"
The roommate who was playing music took off his headphones and looked at him with concern.
"It's okay."
Chen Luo waved his hand and dragged his heavy body out of the balcony.
Spreading on the chair, staring at the ceiling absently, he let out a long breath, feeling quite relieved.
While the entries enhance the functions of the internal organs, they also seem to repair the body in a very rough way.
Chen Luo is twenty-two years old this year. Although he is still young, he is definitely not very healthy because he has established bad habits such as staying up late and eating irregularly early.
This indirectly caused the fusion process of [organ strengthening] to become very torturous and lengthy.
Fortunately, it's worth it.
"Huh——"
Take a short break for a few minutes.
Chen Luo took a long breath again, straightened his back and sat upright.
He picked up the mirror on the table.
When he just walked out of the toilet, his face was still as pale as paper.
And now.
With each breath, as the air continues to be poured into the lungs, it is transformed into power and transported to all parts of the body.
His face turned red at a speed visible to the naked eye.
The physical fatigue quickly faded away and was replaced by a steady stream of physical strength.
Every minute and every second, his spirit became more exciting, his body became lighter, and he felt like he had been completely transformed.
But, a feeling is a feeling after all.
How the body changes will require actual testing.
Chen Luo looked at the time.
It is now 5:30 in the afternoon, and there is still an hour before the training camp ends.
The gangster looked familiar in the past, looked for the entry, and tested the changes in the body, and it was just right.
Think of this.
Chen Luo got up and left the dormitory, rushing to the playground.
.......
Five minutes later.
When Chen Luo arrived at the track, Ding Wei and other long-distance runners seemed to have just finished a round of practice and were standing nearby to rest.
As for those students who were joining in the fun, they were sitting on the lawn in groups of twos and threes, happily watching the practicing players.
"Children, your father is back."
When he came to the runway, Chen Luo spread his arms and dominated the world.
"Fuck, why... I didn't beat you to death, you idiot."
Even though Ding Wei was breathing heavily, he never forgot to raise his middle finger.
"Brother-in-law? Didn't you ask for leave?"
Li Jiale came trotting over, looking a little surprised.
"I just had diarrhea. It's much better now. I just came to train for a while."
Hear the words.
Li Jiale looked Chen Luo up and down doubtfully.
Seeing that his face was rosy and his hair was full of energy, it would be an exaggeration to say that he had taken aphrodisiacs. He looked nothing like a person who had just had diarrhea.
And Chen Luo looks... a little stronger than yesterday?
